dataset_name: Chancay vs. Callao Maritime Logistics & Trans-Pacific Freight Snapshot
domain: Maritime Logistics, Port Operations & International Supply Chain Intelligence

ports_analyzed.name: Megapuerto de Chancay
ports_analyzed.target_vessels: Ultra Large Container Vessels (ULCV up to 24,000 TEUs)

ports_analyzed.name: Puerto del Callao
ports_analyzed.operator: APM Terminals Callao / DP World Callao

schema.Booking_Date: Dispatch and port bill of lading date (YYYY-MM-DD)
schema.Origin_Port: Terminal port: Megapuerto de Chancay vs. Puerto del Callao (String)
schema.Maritime_Route: Direct Pacific route vs. North/Central America transshipment (String)
schema.Cargo_Type: Merchandise classification: Agroexport Reefer, Minerals, General, etc. (String)
schema.Transit_Time_Days: Ocean transit duration from terminal departure to Asian berth (Float)
schema.Port_Dwell_Hours: Yard turnaround and container dwell duration in terminal (Float)
schema.Freight_Rate_USD_TEU: Ocean freight tariff per container unit in USD (Float)
schema.Total_Freight_USD: Total ocean freight expenditure in USD (Float)
schema.Terminal_Handling_USD: Port terminal handling charges (THC) in USD (Float)
schema.Demurrage_Cost_USD: Detention and dwell demurrage penalties in USD (Float)
schema.CO2_Emissions_Tons: Estimated bunker fuel CO2 footprint per consignment (Float)
schema.Delivery_Status: Service level compliance: On-Time vs. Delayed (String)

sources: Drewry World Container Index & Freight Benchmarks
Cosco Shipping Ports & Terminal Portuario Multipropósito de Chancay
